Use case: illustration-story. Create a polished cinematic STORYBOARD SHEET for Logic Legends, stylized low-poly fantasy matching the supplied actual Unity asset screenshots. References are environment guides, not edit targets: omit all Unity UI/gizmos. Clean cream paper, dark ink typography, thin panel borders, cinematic color thumbnails, yellow camera-motion arrows inside panels. Generous legible annotation strips beneath EACH frame labeled CAMERA, TRANSITION, VO, SFX. Draw storyboard art, not a screenshot collage. Preserve actual architecture: floating stone sanctuary in clouds, white fluted columns, conifers, grass, gold altar cradling tall double-pointed faceted BLUE crystal with gold mid-ring and small blue side gems. No invented castle replacing Sanctuary. Landscape 16:9 frames. All text in English, no game HUD. Produce SHEET 1 of 3, four panels in a 2x2 grid, large high resolution sheet. Heading "LOGIC LEGENDS — OPENING CINEMATIC" subtitle "01–04 • A realm in balance". Each frame numbered clearly.
01 AN INVITATION: sweeping wide floating Sanctuary, cloud sea and trees. Camera curved lateral arrow plus gentle push toward altar. Below: CAMERA: Wide sweep + slow push in. TRANSITION: Continuous glide. VO: “Stay awhile… and listen…” “Beyond the world you know… lies a realm shaped by logic…” SFX: Soft wind, gentle magical ambience.
02 THE LOGIC REALM: symmetrical approach between white columns with gold details and floating mathematical symbols, central altar distant. CAMERA: Lateral glide → centered altar. TRANSITION: Soft dissolve. VO: “A world governed not by chaos… but by truth… reasoning… and structure…” “The Logic Realm…” SFX: Gentle musical swell.
03 THE PILLAR OF LOGIC: medium low-angle reveal of the pristine blue crystal on gold altar identical to reference. Camera forward arrow and upward tilt arrow. CAMERA: Dolly forward + tilt up. TRANSITION: Continue pushing closer. VO: “At its core… stands the Pillar of Logic…” “The force that binds all knowledge… into balance…” SFX: Steady crystal hum.
04 INTO DARKNESS: extreme close blue crystal facets, image falls toward black on right, small end-black inset permissible within same numbered frame. CAMERA: Slow push to extreme close-up. TRANSITION: Fade to black. VO: Dramatic pause. SFX: Hum falls into silence.
Keep all narration readable and exact. No cracks yet in panels1–3. Panel4 unsettling glow only.
